summary: The PR addresses the issue of overriding the 'empty_label' in ModelAdmin when using radio_fields, but there are some considerations regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the 'empty_label' is correctly overridden when using radio_fields. There should be a test case added to ensure this behavior.
The PR does not update the relevant documentation to reflect the change in behavior regarding the 'empty_label' when using radio_fields. The documentation should be updated to clarify this behavior.
